units.source_text: 作为标记的草袋子，尽管一半埋在沙里，但还能清晰地看出来。

en.t: The straw bag used as a marker was still clearly visible, even though half of it was buried in the sand.
He definitely had not mistaken the place.

units.source_text: 难道，绳梯叫沙子给吞没了吗？

en.t: Could the rope ladder have been swallowed up by the sand?

units.source_text: ……他猛扑过去，把手臂伸进沙子里掏摸起来。

en.t: ...He lunged forward and thrust his arm into the sand, groping around.

units.source_text: 沙子毫无抵抗地崩塌，沉陷下去。

en.t: The sand collapsed without the slightest resistance and sank down.

units.source_text: 他连一根针都没找到，一次不行，再来几次，结果还是一样。

en.t: He could not find so much as a needle; once failed, and several more tries ended the same way.

units.source_text: ……他竭力遏制住心里涌上的阵阵不安，呆呆地，又重新望了一眼沙壁斜坡的陡峭程度。

en.t: ...Struggling to hold back the waves of unease rising inside him, he stared blankly and once again looked at how steep the slope of the sand wall was.
